subject: The 16th signal: newsletter intent
body:
Newsletter coverage is a signal source that sits beside the 15 you run, and it answers a different question: which publications write about an account, which brands buy space in them, and whether those lists are rising.

NewsletterFIT derives that from the newsletter ecosystem with AI reading every issue: publications, articles, sponsors, brands, people, mentions and momentum, each record carrying its source URL and date.

Your closest comparables show the shape of it. Clay appears in 92 articles across 56 publications in our graph, Apollo in 102 across 88, Databar and SyncGTM not at all.

I can send a sample joined the way your grid would use it, over the REST API ([DOCS_LINK]) or the MCP server ([MCP_LINK]).
